blocks.title: Nad Al Sheba – Meydan
blocks.text: AN ICONIC LOCATION Nad Al Sheba – Meydan Located within the Mohamed Bin Rashed Al Maktoum City District, the site is across from Nad Al Sheba and is located adjacent to a crystal lagoon with uninterrupted views of Downtown Dubai. The development is situated within a renowned zone that creates endless possibilities for a truly exceptional lifestyle. 3 Minutes to Nad Al Sheba 15 Minutes to Meydan Racecourse 19 Minutes

blocks.title: Inspired By The Catwalk
blocks.text: SPACIOUS INTERIORS Inspired By The Catwalk Inspired by the brand’s fashion collections, the aesthetics boast the beauty of the brand’s versatility and simplicity, enhancing the experience of life within these one-of-a-kind villas. Each villa features a central catwalk, boasting a grand entrance in the center and different lifestyle zones on either side, creating an exclusive experience for residents and their guests.

blocks.title: The Karl Lagerfeld Clubhouse
blocks.text: THE FLOATING JEWEL The Karl Lagerfeld Clubhouse The Pavilion offers exclusive facilities to all residents, such as “The Club”, an entertainment space for all ages, “The Library”, a lounge named after KARL LAGERFELD’s passion for books and libraries, a gym and a fitness studio, an adult pool inspired by the beach, and a kids’ pool, all surrounded by immaculately landscaped areas and parks.
